newsitem.title: USA: Standish Care closes reverse merger.
newsitem.headline: Standish Care closes reverse merger.

text.p: The Standish Care Co and CareMatrix Corp said on Friday it had completed its previously announced reverse merger with CareMatrix, giving CareMatrix holders about 92 percent of Standish Care's stock.
The newly combined company will now be known as CareMatrix Corp, the company said.

The companies said they will attempt to sell 6.25 million post-split shares of the company to the public. The company plans a one-for-five reverse stock split to be effective October 14, 1996, the companies said.
The companies said they expect to raise approximately $124 million net of offering costs to support future growth and acquisitions.
